function.description: Save a PNG screenshot of the current page into the workspace (screenshots/) and return its path. To show it, attach that path with message(media_paths=[...]).
function.name: browser_screenshot

parameters.description: Model for saving a screenshot of the current page into the workspace.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page, not only the viewport

name.description: File name without a folder (".png" is added); default: a timestamp
